answer: Referral graphs chain identities to a backer. First, a newcomer attaches to an introducer locking 100 units 12 epochs, max 3 per epoch. Then, neighbors cross-check over 4 epochs; graphs over 0.6 get flagged. Finally, forgery freezes the chain, suspends the introducer 10 epochs. A tundra of loose clones: a wharf of 1,000 needs 34 introducers locking 3,400, at 40% detection expected loss 13,600, while one ember of star clustering exposes the ring.
